name: TwoSiteBind
formula: Bmax1 * x / (k1 + x) + Bmax2 * x / (k2 + x)

name: Cubic
formula: A + B * x + C * x^2 + D * x^3

name: ExpDec2
formula: A1 * exp(-x / t1) + A2 * exp(-x / t2) + y0

name: ExpDec3
formula: A1 * exp(-x / t1) + A2 * exp(-x / t2) + A3 * exp(-x / t3) + y0

name: ExpGro2
formula: A1 * exp(x / t1) + A2 * exp(x / t2) + y0

name: ExpGro3
formula: A1 * exp(x / t1) + A2 * exp(x / t2) + A3 * exp(x / t3) + y0

name: ExpLinear
formula: p1 * exp(-x / p2) + p3 + p4 * x

name: Extreme
formula: y0 + A * exp(-exp(-((x - xc) / w)) - (x - xc) / w + 1)

name: ExpGrowDec
formula: x < xc ? y0 + Ad + Ag*(exp(-xc/tg) - exp(-x/tg)) : y0 + Ad*exp(-(x-xc)/td)

name: Gauss
formula: y0 + A / (w * sqrt(pi / 2)) * exp(-2 * ((x - xc) / w)^2)

name: Lanczos3
formula: b1 * exp(-b2 * x) + b3 * exp(-b4 * x) + b5 * exp(-b6 * x)

name: Langevin
formula: y0 + C * (cosh(x - xc) / sinh(x - xc) - 1 / (x - xc))

name: LogNormal
formula: y0 + A / (sqrt(2 * pi) * w * x) * exp(-ln(x / xc)^2 / (2 * w^2))

name: LangevinMod
formula: y0 + C * (cosh((x - xc) / s) / sinh((x - xc) / s) - 1 / ((x - xc) / s))

name: MixedModelInhib
formula: Vmax / (1 + Ic / (Alpha * Ki)) * x / (Km * (1 + Ic / Ki) / (1 + Ic / (Alpha * Ki)) + x)

name: PWL2
formula: x < xi ? a1 + k1*x : a1 + k1*xi + k2*(x-xi)

name: Reich
formula: a1 * exp(-b1 * x) + a2 * exp(-b2 * x)

name: SineDamp
formula: y0 + A * exp(-x / t0) * sin(pi * (x - xc) / w)

name: SLogistic2
formula: a / (1 + (a - y0) / y0 * exp(-4 * Wmax * x / a))

name: SawtoothWave
formula: y0 + A / T * (x - floor((x - x0) / T) * T - x0)

name: SchulzFlory
formula: y0 + A * exp((xc - x) / w) * (x / xc)^(xc / w)

name: UncompInhib
formula: Vmax / (1 + Ic / Kia) * x / (Km / (1 + Ic / Kia) + x)

derived.name: FWHM
derived.formula: 0.5346 * wL + sqrt(0.2166 * wL * wL + wG * wG)
